tasks.instruction: Wstaw wyraz podany wielkimi literami w odpowiedniej formie gramatycznej, np. BIG - bigger, WATCH - watched, BEAUTY - beautiful.

items.sentence: __________ speaking, I don't believe any of his promises.
This film is really violent, it's not __________ for children.
Three __________ paintings were stolen from The National Gallery yesterday.
I don't really like girls with short hair, I prefer medium __________ hair.
He grew up without parents, it was a difficult __________.
My cousin Laura is really good at __________.
Our youngest son is in hospital, so we've had some __________ nights recently.
Would you believe that he's already had 5 __________?
It's __________ outside, you'd better put on your scarf and gloves.
I can't stand this __________, 42 degrees is too much for me.
